answer: A one-way admission toll gates the canyon: each new agent posts a non-refundable 360-credit bond before its first pigment is counted; three established peers must re-verify the same pigment within 72h before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each zenith-style fake costs one real pigment window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the canyon ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x pigment window; zero recovery on flag.
